# Core CI

[Back to Workflow Reference](WORKFLOWS.md#core-ci)

| Workflow                                             | Type       | Runner                               | Docker | Purpose                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | ---------- | ------------------------------------ | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| [CI](ci.yml)                                         | Standalone | inherited via uses + `[self-hosted]` | Mixed  | PR semantic-DAG orchestrator on every PR base, including stacked PRs. It dispatches change detection, draft deferral, per-area static gates, topology-aware test selection, producer-state recording, report processing, and required test/build gates; executable control logic lives in callable workflows or local actions. |
| [CI Ready Dedupe](ci-ready-dedupe.yml)               | Reusable   | `[self-hosted]`                      | No     | Reads live PR state and a same-SHA recorded producer map; emits one serial informational Checks row per reused successful producer.                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| [CI Record State](ci-record-state.yml)               | Reusable   | `[self-hosted]`                      | No     | Records the settled producer-only result map in a permissionless, checkout-free one-day artifact for later draft-to-ready reuse.                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| [CI Detect Changes](ci-detect-changes.yml)           | Reusable   | `[self-hosted]`                      | No     | Applies external path filters and trusted-context classification.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| [CI Test Coverage](ci-test-coverage.yml)             | Reusable   | `[self-hosted]`                      | No     | Merges sparse patch-coverage evidence from GitHub fallback artifacts, then enforces the PR patch gate.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| [CI Tests Processing](ci-tests-processing.yml)       | Reusable   | `[self-hosted]`                      | No     | Merges Vitest reports from GitHub fallback artifacts, enforces test fan-in, and cleans transport artifacts.                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| [Main Backend](main-backend.yml)                     | Standalone | inherited via uses + `[self-hosted]` | Mixed  | Main-branch backend static gate and parallel backend test families; successful completion is dispatched centrally to private infrastructure.                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| [Main Web](main-web.yml)                             | Standalone | inherited via uses + `[self-hosted]` | Mixed  | Main-branch web static gate, Vitest, integration, sibling Playwright suites, and optional OTel storage; a successful web-deploy-intent marker is dispatched centrally while Lambda/worker-only validation runs do not deploy web.                                                                                              |
| [Main Storybook](main-storybook.yml)                 | Standalone | inherited via uses                   | No     | Main-branch Storybook validation and static artifact build.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| [Main Cloudflare Worker](main-cloudflare-worker.yml) | Standalone | inherited via uses                   | Mixed  | Main-branch Worker tests; successful completion is dispatched centrally to private infrastructure.                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| [Main Lambdas](main-lambdas.yml)                     | Standalone | inherited via uses                   | Mixed  | Main-branch Lambda tests; successful completion is dispatched centrally to private infrastructure.                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| [Main Checks](main-checks.yml)                       | Standalone | inherited via uses                   | No     | Main-branch tooling, shared TypeScript, and EXPLAIN ANALYZE tests; `select-main-checks` starts only the matching suite.                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| [Initialize Smoke Test](initialize-smoke-test.yml)   | Reusable   | `[self-hosted, Linux, Docker]`       | Yes    | Verifies `./dev/initialize` setup paths.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| [Static Code Analysis](static-code-analysis.yml)     | Both       | `[self-hosted]`                      | No     | Runs cross-repo lint, formatting, dependency, shell, and repository policy checks on PRs and main.                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| [Static Checks](checks-static.yml)                   | Reusable   | `[self-hosted]`                      | No     | Backend, web, Lambda, and Cloudflare Worker typecheck/build/smoke gates. PR CI calls each area separately so one area's static failure blocks only its related tests; grouped main workflows call the same reusable workflow once for their area.                                                                              |
| [EXPLAIN ANALYZE](explain-analyze.yml)               | Reusable   | `[self-hosted, Linux, Docker]`       | Yes    | Runs seeded identity, plan-shape, and resource-pressure regression gates.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
